chunks: From him, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Regarding half a lash and a third of a lash — one grabs the whip at half its length and two-thirds of its length.

key_terms.السَّوْطِ: al-sawt — the whip or lash; the instrument used in corporal punishment
key_terms.الْجَلْدَةِ: al-jalda — a single stroke/lash; the basic unit of corporal punishment in Islamic penal law
key_terms.ثُلُثَيِ: thuluthayn — two-thirds; the grip point on the whip for a one-third lash penalty
key_terms.نِصْفِ: nisf — half; indicating fractional penalties reduced from the full prescribed punishment

ai.seo_question: How is a half lash or one-third lash penalty carried out in Islamic law according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the practical method of implementing fractional lashing penalties in Islamic jurisprudence. When a judicial sentence specifies half a lash or one-third of a lash, the executor accomplishes this by gripping the whip at the midpoint or at two-thirds of its length, thereby reducing the force of the strike proportionally. This ruling provided a practical mechanism for jurists to enforce reduced penalties without requiring physical division of the whip.
